decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-b598b51801ea] names the subject exactly: the Prometheus metric `cilium_node_health_connectivity_status`. It appears in the 1.17 Upgrade Notes under "Added Metrics", which shows the change is an addition. The surrounding section ([ev-34619549fb8a] and the other items) is a plain list of newly added metrics. Nothing in it describes breakage or required operator action, so the consequence is only that a new metric becomes available. The proposals left the subject open because no subject family covers metrics. That is a gap in the taxonomy, not in the evidence, which identifies the subject without ambiguity.
